raw_segments.text: Alyosha went out in tears. Such distrustfulness in Midia, such lack of confidence even to
him, to Alyosha. All this suddenly opened before Alyosha an unsuspected depth of hopeless
grief and despair in the soul of his unhappy brother. Intense, infinite compassion overwhelmed
him instantly. There was a poignant ache in his torn heart.
"'Love Ivan!' he suddenly recalled Midia's words. And he was going to Ivan. He badly
wanted to see Ivan all day.
He was as much worried about Ivan as about Midia, and more than ever now."
